info.title: TinyLap Timing API
info.description: Lap timing for a club's track, or your own. Decoders post passings, over the internet with their own token or through a signed-in browser tab connected by USB; the server stores each passing once, turns passings into laps, practice, qualifying and race results, and streams them as Server-Sent Events. A read-only watchers view needs no sign-in.

externalDocs.description: The passing format, the ingest API and the ZRound extension

302.description: Back to the page that asked.

get.summary: Who is signed in, with their personal space and clubs
The live state of a club or personal space: track, session, standings, recent crossings, drivers, personal bests

get.description: Events: snapshot, session, crossing, standings, results, drivers, track, setup. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to get what you missed in the last 10 minutes; older, you get a snapshot.

delete.summary: Delete a driver; their transponders become unassigned, their laps stay

put.summary: Assign a transponder to a driver, or unassign it
put.description: Assigning gives the driver the transponder's unassigned laps.

post.summary: Pair a new decoder: answers its id and its token, once

delete.summary: Unpair a decoder; its token stops working, its passings stay

get.summary: The club's tracks, each with its newest layout
get.description: Active tracks first; `?archived=1` adds the archived ones, flagged `archived`. A track is `{ id, name, archived, current, layout }`, the layout `{ plannerId, snapshotKey, attachedAt, by }` or null.

post.summary: Add a track; it does not become current
post.description: Body `{ name, link? }`: a name of 1 to 60 characters, unique among the club's active tracks without regard to case, and optionally a planner share link for its first layout.

409.description: The name is in use, or the track is current, archived or in use.

patch.summary: Rename, archive or restore a track
patch.description: Body `{ name?, archived? }` with at least one. `archived: true` archives, `false` restores. The current track cannot be archived.

409.description: The name is in use, or the track is current, archived or in use.

delete.summary: Delete an archived track with its layouts and records; its sessions stay
delete.description: Needs the delete permission. Refused with 409 while the track is not archived or a running session uses it.

409.description: The name is in use, or the track is current, archived or in use.

post.summary: Attach a layout from a planner link
post.description: Body `{ link, confirm? }`. 201: a new layout was added; 200: the track already has that snapshot. A layout of a different planner track than the current one needs `confirm: true`, else 409 with a `current` member holding the layout it would replace.

201.description: The track, with the new layout.

409.description: The track has a layout of another planner track; resend with `confirm: true`. The problem carries `current`.

put.summary: Make a track current, and set the direction
put.description: Body `{ trackId, direction }`, direction `cw` or `ccw`. Ends a running practice when the track or direction changes. An archived track cannot be made current.

get.summary: The watchers link token, or null

post.summary: Make a new watchers link; the old one stops working
Start a practice, a qualifying or a race
post.description: `kind` is `practice`, `qualifying` or `race`; a practice takes no other field. While a session runs the answer is 409 with the running session in the problem's `running` member, unless `replace` is `true`: then the running session ends (a practice as done, a qualifying or race as aborted) and the new one starts.

409.description: A session is already running; the problem carries it as `running`.

get.summary: A session with its standings and crossings

post.summary: Accounts' notice that these users' memberships changed
post.description: Marks the users' tokens stale and has their open streams check access now. The notice carries no authority: refreshed claims decide. Answers 404 unless the server has a notice token.

401.description: `unauthorized`: the bearer token is missing or wrong.

post.summary: Record a passing by hand for a driver (tap entry)
Post a batch of passings, and decoder logs, of one boot
post.description: Repeating a batch is safe. The answer's `through` is the highest t of this boot the server holds; drop everything up to it from your outbox. `logs` holds `%TLLOG` lines without the `%TLLOG ` prefix and the `&`; they are written to the server's log and not stored, and `passings` may then be empty.

401.description: `unauthorized`. With a token: the token is wrong, or the decoder was unpaired; keep the outbox. From the bridge (session): not signed in; keep the passings and sign in again.

403.description: `forbidden`, from the bridge only: the decoder is in a club or personal space you have no access to, or the request did not come from the app's own pages. Keep the passings: someone with access can send them.

404.description: `not-found`, from the bridge only: there is no such decoder, because it was removed or never paired. It is gone for good: drop these passings.

413.description: `too-large`: the body is over 64 KiB. Keep the passings and send smaller batches.

422.description: `invalid-request`: the batch cannot be read. It is refused whole and nothing of it is stored; it will not be taken as it is. That is a body that is not a JSON object; a `boot` that is not 8 to 32 base64url characters; `passings` missing or not an array, or empty with no lines in `logs`; more than 500 passings; a passing whose `transponder` is not a hex code, or whose `t` is not a whole number of milliseconds, 0 or more; `logs` that is not an array of strings; more than 64 lines in `logs`; an entry over 510 bytes; or over 32 KiB of entries. A log line that cannot be read does not refuse the batch: it is skipped and counted.

429.description: `rate-limited`: wait for the seconds in Retry-After, then send again.

200.description: An event stream without setup events.

post.summary: Timing over MCP: one JSON-RPC message (Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP)
post.description: For assistants: add this URL as a custom connector. Its tools run timing as the signed-in member, with their role in each club: drivers, transponders, tracks, decoders, sessions and the watchers link, but no tap entry and no pairing. Tools that lose data or interrupt a session answer with a question and a confirmation to send back. Needs an access token from accounts for this URL with the `timing` scope; without one the answer is 401 with a `WWW-Authenticate` challenge that names the metadata below. Cookies are ignored.

200.description: The JSON-RPC answer, or an event stream.

401.description: No valid token: sign in through accounts.

get.summary: Not served: there is no server-to-client stream

delete.summary: Not served: there are no MCP sessions to end

get.summary: The same metadata at the root, for clients that look there
RFC 9728 protected resource metadata for /mcp: its authorization server and scopes

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details; the type ends in one of the problem names below.

session.name: __Host-tinylap-session
session.description: The sign-in session. Writes must come from the app's own pages.

noticeToken.description: The token accounts sends its membership notices with.

decoderToken.description: A decoder's token, from pairing. It can only post that decoder's passings.

mcpToken.description: An access token from accounts for /mcp with the `timing` scope, which an MCP client gets by signing in with its Client ID Metadata Document and the member's consent.

not-found.title: Not found
not-found.description: No such route, club, personal space, driver, decoder, track, session or watchers link, or it is not one of yours. Posting passings for a decoder that exists but is not yours is forbidden instead.

method-not-allowed.title: Method not allowed
method-not-allowed.description: The Allow header lists the methods this URL supports.

unavailable.title: The service is unavailable
unavailable.description: Timing data cannot be read or stored right now, or sign-in is unavailable.

unauthorized.title: Not signed in
unauthorized.description: Sign in, or send a valid decoder token or notice token.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.description: Your role may not do this, or the request did not come from the app's own pages.

invalid-request.title: The request is not valid
invalid-request.description: A field is missing or out of range; the detail says which.

too-large.title: The request is too large
too-large.description: A request body may be at most 64 KiB.

rate-limited.title: Too many requests
rate-limited.description: Wait for the number of seconds in Retry-After.

conflict.title: Something else is running
conflict.description: A session is already running here; end or abort it, wait for it to end, or start with `replace`. Also: a track name is in use, or a track is current, archived or in use for what was asked.

no-session.title: No session is running
no-session.description: A tap needs a running session; start a practice first.

not-a-circuit.title: The track is not a closed circuit
not-a-circuit.description: Only a closed circuit has a track to time. Close the loop in the planner and share it again.

planner-unavailable.title: The planner cannot be reached
planner-unavailable.description: The planner did not answer or answered with an error; try again.

login-failed.title: The sign-in could not be completed
login-failed.description: The sign-in expired or was tampered with. Sign in again.
